title: manual_writer completion
description: Lightweight terminal marker — the manual section CONTENT lives in the .md file the agent wrote/updated; this payload only records what was done so the cascade can audit and the next run knows the prior outcome.

title.description: Human-readable section heading echoed from agent_params.

decision.description: Outcome — created (cold-start writeNewFile), updated (warm-start updateFile), or no_change (scene matched prior, nothing written).

output_path.description: Workspace-relative path the agent wrote to (typically `manual/20-walkthrough-<feature_id>.md`).

summary.description: One-sentence summary of what changed (for audit logs).

warnings.description: Advisory notes — capture was empty, file was unwriteable, scene didn't match expectation, etc.

errors.description: Hard failures the agent recovered from.
